problems.title: A tangent slope from the scanned formula
problems.question: For y=e^x+lnx, find the tangent of the tangent line’s inclination at A=(1,e).
problems.idea: The tangent of the inclination equals the derivative.
steps: At x=1 the derivative is e+1.
The function value is e+ln1=e, confirming the point.
problems.note: The scan has e^x+lnx, a sum. Reading it as e^(x+lnx) would produce a different derivative.

problems.title: A cube-root difference and a power limit
problems.question: Find (a) lim(∛(n³+n²)-n); (b) lim((n²+2)/n²)^(n²).
problems.idea: Factor the first difference of cubes and use the standard exponential limit for the second.
steps: (a) Put u=∛(n³+n²),v=n. The difference equals n²/(u²+un+n²). Dividing by n² gives limit 1/3.
(b) The expression is (1+2/n²)^(n²), whose limit is e².

problems.title: Logarithms as ratios of two unknown logs
problems.question: Given log_(ab)a=4, find logₐb and log_(ab)(∛a/√b).
steps: Then logₐb=B/A=-3/4.
The second expression is (A/3-B/2)/(A+B).
Substitute B=-3A/4 and A+B=A/4 to get (1/3+3/8)·4=17/6.

problems.title: Shade regions where two factors have opposite signs
problems.question: Describe and shade log₂(xy)(x²+y²-25)<0.
problems.idea: Separate the logarithm’s domain from its sign.
formulas: Domain xy>0; log₂(xy)>0 iff xy>1, and it is negative iff 0<xy<1.
steps: The product is negative either when xy>1 and x²+y²<25, or when 0<xy<1 and x²+y²>25.
These regions lie only in quadrants I and III.
The axes, hyperbola xy=1 and circle x²+y²=25 are excluded because the logarithm is undefined or the product is zero there.

problems.title: An odd rational function with two increasing branches
problems.question: Study f(x)=x-1/x, sketch it, and state its asymptotes.
problems.idea: Use its derivative and its difference from y=x.
steps: The domain is ℝ\{0}; f is odd, with zeros at x=±1 and range ℝ.
It is strictly increasing on each interval (-∞,0) and (0,∞), with no local extrema. It is convex for x<0 and concave for x>0.
As x→0-, f→∞; as x→0+, f→-∞. Thus x=0 is a vertical asymptote.
As x→±∞, f(x)-x→0, so y=x is the slant asymptote.
problems.answer: Vertical asymptote x=0; slant asymptote y=x. Both branches increase on their own domains.

problems.title: A logarithmic inequality valid for every x
problems.question: Find a so log_(a/(a+1))(x²+2)≥1 for every real x.
problems.idea: The argument is unbounded and has minimum 2.
steps: A base 0<b<1 fails for large x, so b>1.
For b>1 the least logarithm occurs at x=0, requiring log_b2≥1, or b≤2.
Thus 1<a/(a+1)≤2. The first condition forces a<-1; on that interval the second gives a≤-2.

problems.title: A parallel cylinder section
problems.question: A cylinder section parallel to the axis is distance 4 cm from it. Its area divided by lateral area is √5/(3π). Find the cylinder radius.
steps: The ratio gives √(R²-16)/R=√5/3.
Squaring yields 1-16/R²=5/9, hence R²=36.

problems.title: Cone inscribed in a sphere
problems.question: A cone is inscribed in a radius-25 ball; its generator makes angle α with the base and sinα=3/5. Find total surface area and volume.
problems.idea: Relate generator l and height h through the sphere’s axial circle.
steps: Total area=πr(r+l)=π·24·54=1296π.

problems.title: Rotate an ellipse about its major coordinate axis
problems.question: Find the volume enclosed when x²/a²+y²/b²=1 is rotated about the x-axis.
steps: Integrate: V=πb²[x-x³/(3a²)] from -a to a.
This equals 4πab²/3.

problems.title: Minimize an intercept tetrahedron
problems.question: A plane ax+by+2z-10=0 with a,b>0 passes through (1,2,1). Find the least volume of its tetrahedron with the coordinate planes.
problems.idea: Minimize the reciprocal of ab under its linear constraint.
steps: From (a+2b)²≥8ab we get ab≤8.
Equality occurs at a=2b, giving a=4,b=2.
The minimum volume is 250/(3·8)=125/12.
